question: Who launched the 'Ayushman Bhava' campaign in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Droupadi Murmu**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The '**Ayushman Bhava' campaign was initiated by the Government of India in 2023 **to ensure the delivery of comprehensive healthcare services at the grassroots level.
 
• It **aligns with the broader vision of achieving universal health coverage under the Ayushman Bharat Scheme**.
 
• President Droupadi Murmu formally launched this campaign, emphasizing its significance in improving healthcare access and quality, particularly in rural and underserved areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The campaign focuses on**:

 
 
• Ayushman Aapke Dwar 3.0 - To ensure eligible beneficiaries are identified and issued Ayushman Bharat cards.
 
• Seva Pakhwada (Service Fortnight) - Encouraging healthcare awareness and enrollment activities.
 
• Gram Panchayat Health Melas - Organized at the village level to promote health and wellness.
 
• By involving local administrations, healthcare providers, and communities, the initiative seeks to bring health services closer to people, ensuring no one is left behind.​
